newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tieto hits new high after acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Tieto hits new high after acquisition.

text.p: Finnish data servies group TT Tieto hit a new life-high on strong demand on Friday after the group on Thursday announced it would buy a majority in post and telecoms systems data provider Avancer Oy, brokers said.
At 0945 GMT, TT Tieto traded at 295.00 markka, up 19.00 markka or some seven percent, after hitting a new life high 300.00. Trade was a relatively lively 18 million markka.

The stock's previous life-high of 276.00 markka was set on Thursday after TT Tieto said it would buy 70 percent of PT Finland's Avancer, and PT Finland had acquired the Finnish's state's 27.4 percent holding in TT Tieto. @
Brokers said there were both domestic and overseas investors buying TT Tieto.
